summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests alisertib taken together with paclitaxel in adults with small cell lung cancer. Alisertib is taken by mouth twice a day on Days 1 to 7, and paclitaxel is given through a vein on Days 1 and 8 of each 21-day cycle. The main measure is the percentage of side effects, mild and serious, graded by NCI CTCAE version 5.0, to see how well participants tolerate the combination at different alisertib doses.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa alisertib combinado con paclitaxel en adultos con cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas. El alisertib se toma por vía oral dos veces al día del día 1 al 7, y el paclitaxel se administra por vena los días 1 y 8 de cada ciclo de 21 días. El resultado principal es el porcentaje de efectos secundarios, leves y graves, clasificados según los CTCAE del NCI versión 5.0, para medir qué tan bien toleran los participantes la combinación con distintas dosis de alisertib.
who_for: Age 18 years or older at consent
Pathologically confirmed small cell lung cancer
Prior platinum-based chemotherapy and anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 immunotherapy
Up to one additional systemic therapy for SCLC, for a total of up to 2 prior regimens
Measurable disease as defined by RECIST v1.1
not_for: Prior treatment with an AURKA-specific or pan-Aurora targeted agent, including alisertib, in any setting
